mechanics.claim: Braum dashes to a target allied champion or minion; on arrival both gain the bonus armor and magic resistance.
mechanics.quote: '''Braum''' {{tip|dashes}} to put himself {{tt|between|150 units from his ally towards the closest enemy}} the target ally and the closest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tt|within 1500 units|from the ally's location}}, and upon arrival grants himself and the ally {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: If self cast, the bonus resistances (at the higher, self rate) are granted to Braum instantly with no dash.
mechanics.quote: ''Stand Behind Me'' can be [[Self-targeted|self cast]] to instantly grant '''Braum''' the '''bonus''' resistances.

mechanics.claim: If the dash is interrupted, neither Braum nor his ally receive the bonus resistances.
mechanics.quote: If the {{tip|dash}} is interrupted, neither '''Braum''' nor his ally receive the bonus resistances.

mechanics.claim: Unbreakable can be cast during the W dash, potentially letting Q and R also be cast then.
mechanics.quote: If {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} is cast during the dash, {{ai|Winter's Bite|Braum}} and {{ai|Glacial Fissure|Braum}} may also be cast.
